info.name: NAQLAH - Skill Extraction and Student Skills
info.description: Runnable Postman requests and HTTP examples for ClickUp task z8uq9mb1mk. Use the local environment template and two fresh disposable students. The Skill Extraction & Student Skills folder can be copied into the shared NAQLAH Backend collection.

item.name: Skill Extraction & Student Skills
item.description: Set base_url and the two disposable student credentials in a local environment. Keep the cookie jar enabled and run the subfolders in order. Set the Postman working directory to the folder containing fixtures/. See verification.md for individual endpoint statuses, exact run results and setup.

request.description: Send exactly one of text, sections or file. Text is limited to 100,000 characters. Recognized CV sections are Technical Skills, Projects and Experience. Text without recognized headings is treated as a technical-skills excerpt.

exec: pm.test("Source, dictionary and skill state", function () { pm.expect(data.source_type === "cv" && Number.isInteger(data.source_id) && data.dictionary_version === 'naqlah-skills-v0.1.0' && data.candidates.every(c => c.source_type === data.source_type && c.source_id === data.source_id && c.status === 'pending' && c.state === "extracted")).to.equal(true); });

request.description: The source segment must be cv, practical_work or external_course.
An ID outside the supported integer range is treated as an unknown resource.
Returns three arrays: extracted, confirmed and course_covered.

exec: pm.test("Candidates await review and course remains covered", function () { pm.expect(data.extracted.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("work_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'extracted') && data.confirmed.length === 0 && data.course_covered.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("course_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'course_covered')).to.equal(true); });

request.description: Repeating the same source returns the same source and candidate IDs and preserves review states.

exec: pm.test("Same source and decisions", function () { pm.expect(data.source_id === Number(pm.environment.get("cv_source_id")) && data.candidates.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("cv_python_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'confirmed') && data.candidates.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("cv_docker_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'rejected')).to.equal(true); });

response.name: 200 Repeat typed CV extraction after review
422 Reject empty typed CV

request.description: Includes pending, confirmed and rejected candidates with canonical skills and source references. Course candidates can remain pending with state course_covered.

exec: pm.test("Source references, review states and course coverage", function () { pm.expect(Array.isArray(data) && data.every(c => Number.isInteger(c.skill_id) && Number.isInteger(c.source_id) && typeof c.skill_name === 'string' && typeof c.source_type === 'string') && data.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("cv_docker_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'rejected') && data.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("course_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'course_covered')).to.equal(true); });

request.description: Returns unique confirmed canonical skills and confirmed_at timestamps.

exec: pm.test("Only Python and SQL are eligible", function () { pm.expect(data.map(s => s.skill_name)).to.have.members(['python', 'sql']); });
pm.test("Confirmation timestamp and state", function () { pm.expect(data.every(s => typeof s.confirmed_at === 'string' && s.state === 'confirmed')).to.equal(true); });

request.description: Checks persisted matching skills and original course coverage after logout and login.

exec: pm.test("Confirmed skills persisted", function () { pm.expect(data.confirmed.map(s => s.skill_name)).to.have.members(['python', 'sql']); });

pm.test("Course evidence persisted", function () { pm.expect(data.course_covered.some(c => c.candidate_id === Number(pm.environment.get("course_candidate_id")) && c.state === 'course_covered')).to.equal(true); });
